direction_of_travel: Active US-Iran military exchange on June 27-28 — US strikes on Iranian coastal sites, Iran ballistic-missile and drone retaliation on Kuwait/Bahrain — now directly tests the Lucerne roadmap: F8 (p=30%, 3-day horizon) tracks whether Iran formally suspends talks, while F9 (p=8%) confirms Hormuz trade remains far from any recovery threshold and F10 (p=30%) tracks whether IAEA inspectors arrive in Iran by July 10.
